question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"About."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• The use of **"about"** indicates an approximate quantity, suggesting that there are around twenty pairs of ear muffs but not necessarily an exact count. (एक अनुमानित मात्रा, जिससे पता चलता है कि लगभग बीस जोड़ी ईयर मफ हैं लेकिन जरूरी नहीं कि सटीक संख्या हो)
 
• **"About"** in this context suggests that the exact count may not be precise, but there are approximately twenty pairs of ear muffs on the bench.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Professor Sprout was standing behind__ a trestle bench in the centre of the greenhouse. __**About**__ twenty ______ (3) _____ of different-coloured ear muffs ______ (4) ______ lying on the bench. Harry ______ (5) ______ his place between Ron and Hermione.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Utmost: **the most possible. (सबसे अधिक संभव)
 
• **Round: **having the shape of a circle or a ball. (गोल (वृत्त या गेंद के आकार का))
 
• **Near by: **close by. (आस-पास)
